data: Microsoft had the larger gross profit in fiscal 2025. Its gross margin was $193,893 million (about $193.9 billion) for the year ended June 30, 2025, on revenue of $281,724 million. NVIDIA's gross profit was $97,858 million (about $97.9 billion) for the year ended January 26, 2025, on revenue of $130,497 million. Dividing the two, Microsoft's gross profit was roughly 1.98 times NVIDIA's, or just under twice as large. NVIDIA's gross margin percentage was higher, at about 75%, compared with about 69% for Microsoft. The two fiscal years also end at different points in the calendar, with NVIDIA's closing about five months before Microsoft's.
